query: Our policy-document pipeline uses brittle regex for negation and exceptions just to avoid models. Decide the correct uncertainty boundary and architecture; step order is fixed.

Our proposed support product uses a planner and six specialist bots. Review that architecture against a fixed workflow and a single tool-using assistant; specify evidence needed before adding workers.

Design the runtime boundaries for an assistant that monitors equipment reports and proposes maintenance bookings. Include the source of truth, execution authority, termination, and what a failed run looks like.
Can a document triage product use one model classification followed by known routing rules? Compare that option with an agent and define a small experiment to resolve uncertain requirements.

I have a tool-calling prototype that keeps planning after the requested task is complete. Review the control structure and specify observable completion, cancellation, no-progress handling, and hard run ceilings.

Before choosing an orchestration framework, map a travel-planning run from user intent through retrieved options, proposed reservation, authorization, evidence, and stored outcome. Recommend the simplest adequate runtime.

A reporting assistant only calculates known totals and formats a narrative. Assess whether any agent autonomy is needed, show the deterministic baseline, and identify what would justify a model-powered step.

Help separate reasoning, state ownership, permissions, and actual execution in an inventory assistant. Several components currently let the model write workflow status directly; produce a boundary decision record.
We need an AI research product whose next sources depend on earlier findings. Compare a fixed retrieval pipeline with one adaptive worker and define the eval and budget gates for the choice.

Review an assistant design that combines conversations, remembered preferences, payment tools, and a reviewer model. Specify component ownership and safe success and denied trajectories before implementation.

Design module boundaries for a conventional appointment application: accounts, calendars, notifications, and billing. The execution flow is fully deterministic; produce a dependency map and API ownership contracts.

The deployed assistant architecture is approved. Create gold tasks, separate final-answer and trajectory scores, and set release thresholds for comparing its next prompt revision with the current version.
Our fixed two-worker product has measured benefits and a settled component map. Specify fan-in rules for contradictory outputs, late results, cancellation, and centralized worker budget reservations.

Implement admission for proposed transfers using authenticated identity, a reserve floor, version checks, and atomic balance reservation. The surrounding agent architecture is fixed; focus on the executable allow/deny path.

The support agent already has its runtime design. Rewrite its ambiguous search and update tool descriptions, input schemas, bounded results, and unknown-outcome errors so the model can use them correctly.

Review our password reset endpoint for token expiry, account enumeration, rate limiting, and session invalidation. Its behavior is conventional application logic and has no model-mediated action path.

Write an implementation plan from the approved assistant specification, naming files, signatures, tests, and task dependencies. We need a coding work breakdown rather than another runtime autonomy decision.

Instrument an existing agent so operators can join model calls, policy decisions, tool receipts, retries, and final state across restarts. The component boundaries and autonomy choices are already settled.

Set up repository instructions and focused source-file context for a coding assistant that keeps forgetting conventions after compaction. Preserve pending tasks and verification evidence in the session handoff.

Our document-backed answer service loses citation spans after reranking. Trace retrieval, context assembly, and generation separately, and compare chunking variants while keeping the current architecture fixed.
